purpose: Map Arc discovery and wallet-intelligence sources by field and provenance before any cross-chain adapter activation.

source_disposition_legend.ADOPT_SHADOW: Useful enough to ingest only after deterministic adapter validation and point-in-time provenance tests.
source_disposition_legend.RESEARCH_ONLY: Useful context or candidate feature source but not ready for automated ingestion.
source_disposition_legend.REJECT_FIELD: Do not ingest this derived field as framework evidence without independent reconstruction.
source_disposition_legend.UNVERIFIED: Capability or semantics were not independently established in this pass.

verified_observations: New-pair page states pool creation events are read directly from Arc chain for Uniswap v2/v3/v4 and appear when the creation event lands.
Docs distinguish direct-chain launchpad/new-pair data from third-party-indexer charts, holders and historical trades.
Token screener exposes exact contract, price, liquidity, market cap, FDV, volume, transactions, age/first-seen and pool information where available.
Docs state pool pricing is selected from the pool carrying liquidity rather than a synthetic venue average.
Buy routing is simulated before wallet signing, but execution functionality is out of scope for Alpha Lab research.
risks: Current token pages can expose internally inconsistent-looking derived fields, so each field requires semantic tests rather than UI trust.
Names/tickers are explicitly non-unique; exact CA remains identity authority.
No public machine API contract or rate-limit contract was verified in this pass.

verified_observations: UI exposes token, market cap, price, age, transactions, volume, traders, holders and liquidity filters/columns.
UI includes a live swap feed and a Radar launchpad whose tokens are described as live from first trade.
Launchpad states fixed 1B supply and direct Uniswap V3 launch with a forever-locked LP design.
Site currently displays an RPC instability warning.
risks: RPC instability is an explicit availability/freshness risk.
No public machine API, timestamp guarantee or field-formula contract was verified in this pass.
Launchpad claims must be verified against factory/locker bytecode or events before canonical use.

verified_observations: Site claims coverage across ten Arc launchpads/venues in one terminal.
Insider leaderboard is described as top-100 wallets by 30-day on-chain PnL and is recomputed every two minutes.
Intel page states sources include a chain-wide swap index, native USDC balance snapshots every ten minutes, CCTP TokenMessenger events and insider ranking every two minutes.
Intel exposes whale swaps, deployer sells, fresh capital/balance moves, bridge flows and wallet activity.
Terminal exposes market cap, liquidity, volume, top-10 share and insider count.
Token pages can expose bundle share, deployer share/history and top-holder concentration.
risks: Top-wallet rankings are outcome-derived and can create severe hindsight/selection leakage if used as predictive qualification without AS-OF reconstruction.
PnL methodology, cost basis, gas/fees, realizability and unsellable-token treatment require independent audit.
Cluster/bundle/entity labels require deterministic evidence and must not be accepted as identity truth.
Derived token scores must not be imported into Alpha Lab scoring.

verified_observations: Launchpad describes Arc-native USDC bonding-curve launches and a graduation event at a configured market-cap threshold currently presented as $69K.
Displayed ArcFactory source fixes total supply at 1B tokens and can bundle a creator initial buy in the creation transaction.
Displayed factory source includes owner-controlled setParams for virtual reserves, graduation market cap, fee bps and creation fee.
Site says Arc-side CCTP intent infrastructure is deployed while source-chain contracts are not yet live.
risks: Do not assume a timeless $69K graduation threshold: displayed factory code exposes owner-settable parameters.
Marketing statements such as no-admin-keys must be interpreted per launched token/curve, not as proof that factory-level parameters never change.
Cross-chain intent path is not fully live according to the current site.

verified_observations: Arc token pages are web-addressable.
Public BasedBot documentation verifies live new-token/new-pool channels on several networks, but the reviewed docs do not establish the current Arc feed semantics.
risks: The /arc page exposed no useful machine-readable field contract in this pass.
Do not infer Arc behavior from Base/BSC documentation.

verified_observations: Trending table exposes age, mindshare, market cap, price change, holders, fresh-wallet percentage, average buy, net flow, liquidity, volume, fees, transactions and network fields.
risks: Arc support was not independently established from the reviewed public page.
Fresh-wallet and mindshare definitions require methodology and AS-OF semantics before predictive use.
Derived market cap must never override direct live Arc pool/on-chain state.

recommended_adapter_sequence.reason: Strongest currently documented provenance for second-level Arc pool creation events.
Launchpad-specific factory events can distinguish token birth, creator initial buy and graduation.
High information value but derived methodology creates hindsight and entity-resolution risk.

recommended_adapter_sequence.purpose: Independent discovery cross-check and Radar launch-origin source
recommended_adapter_sequence.reason: Useful breadth but current RPC warning and unverified machine API reduce authority.
Current Arc field semantics or Arc support are insufficiently verified for adapter work.

implementation_preconditions: No Arc source becomes canonical market-state authority from this artifact.
A deterministic adapter must preserve exact CA + chain + pool + quote + observed_at + block where available.
Direct event replay must verify new-pair/factory/graduation claims before promotion.
Market cap and FDV formulas must be independently reconstructed from supply semantics.
Derived wallet/PnL/cluster labels remain prediction-excluded until point-in-time replay and negative controls exist.
Source failures and conflicts must emit DEGRADED_DATA or DATA_CONFLICT rather than fall back silently.
Prospective shadow evidence is required before any alert-gate or scoring promotion.

next_eligible_action.action: Build the smallest ArcScreener new-pair discovery adapter as SHADOW_ONLY, using direct creation-event fields only, with deterministic event replay fixtures and no wallet/scoring integration yet.
next_eligible_action.why: This is the minimum step that improves autonomous pre-CA discovery without importing derived smart-money labels or broadening trading authority.
